title: Exterior Design and Styling
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on the G60's exterior design and overall look, with many customers praising the styling, one example criticizing the rear design, and many fragments mentioning design without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the G60's overall design, styling, beauty, and attractive appearance.

negative.summary: The negative feedback present criticizes the rear design as not very good.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the vehicle's design or say it looks nice, but the sampled wording is too brief or incomplete to assess sentiment consistently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short design mentions with limited context, which leaves a large undetermined portion.
The examples focus narrowly on exterior design and styling, so other possible design-related aspects are not evidenced here.
The sample is stratified and not representative, so it should not be used to infer overall prevalence beyond the supplied counts.
